title: Har Ghar Tiranga Abhiyan Online Registration 2022
organization: Ministry of Culture / Government of India
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit official Har Ghar Tiranga campaign website
2. Register with mobile number
3. Pledge to hoist the National Flag
4. Upload selfie during campaign dates
5. Download e-certificate if issued
shortDescription: Har Ghar Tiranga Abhiyan Online Registration 2022 – join the Independence Day campaign on the official portal.
content:
Har Ghar Tiranga Abhiyan 2022 was a flagship public participation campaign under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav.

Citizens registered online, hoisted Tiranga at homes, and uploaded selfies for digital certificates. Follow Flag Code guidelines at all times.
